slice: PL Workflow Hardware and Research Platform

capabilities.name: Advanced Workflow Execution
capabilities.description: Support branching, chaining, conditions, parallel steps, joins, retries, timeouts, compensation, cancellation, resource locks, variables, typed data, and subworkflows.
capabilities.source: v1.18 — Wave 1.18.1 Advanced visual workflow editor and execution model

capabilities.name: Workflow Triggers Scheduling and Packs
capabilities.description: Provide project, file, cell, task, build, test, commit, export, device, threshold, timer, and manual triggers plus reusable workflow packs.
capabilities.source: v1.18 — Wave 1.18.2 Triggers schedules templates packs and orchestration
capabilities.notes: Runaway loops, duplicate runs, and hidden external actions must be prevented.

capabilities.name: Workflow Tracing and Analytics
capabilities.description: Record workflow inputs, outputs, duration, retries, resource use, logs, providers, provenance, failures, run history, and bottlenecks.
capabilities.source: v1.18 — Wave 1.18.3 Workflow diagnostics analytics execution tracing and command center

capabilities.name: Device Discovery and Plugin Foundation
capabilities.description: Provide USB, serial, scanner, sensor, and device discovery, identity, connection profiles, permissions, reconnect, health, capabilities, and safe removal.
capabilities.source: v1.18 — Wave 1.18.4 USB serial scanners sensors and device plugin foundation
capabilities.notes: Device access must be explicit and sandboxed where practical.

capabilities.name: Firmware and Embedded Workflow Integration
capabilities.description: Support source, toolchain detection, build, flash, monitor, logging, device selection, test, artifacts, diagnostics, and recovery workflows.
capabilities.source: v1.18 — Wave 1.18.5 Firmware and embedded workflows
capabilities.notes: Automatic flashing and privileged device operations require explicit confirmation.

capabilities.name: Live Data Pipeline Recording and Replay
capabilities.description: Provide typed timestamped data streams with units, schemas, transforms, filters, buffering, storage, checkpoints, backpressure, monitoring, recording, replay, calibration, and export.
capabilities.source: v1.18 — Wave 1.18.6 Data pipelines live monitoring recording replay and calibration
capabilities.notes: Data can feed Sheets, simulation, Docs, models, games, animation, and workflows.

capabilities.name: Integrated Research Project Workflow
capabilities.description: Track experiments, methods, assumptions, devices, datasets, simulations, plots, citations, versions, notes, measured results, and reproducibility metadata.
capabilities.source: v1.18 — Wave 1.18.7 Research projects experiment tracking visualization and reproducibility
capabilities.notes: Measured hardware data should be comparable against simulation results.

capabilities.name: Research Reporting and Reproducibility
capabilities.description: Generate linked Docs reports, Sheets analysis, visualizations, complete result packages, provenance records, and recoverable scientific workflows.
capabilities.source: v1.18 — Validation and public-beta release gate
